title: wkchat auto-startup HKCU\Run registration -- per-cwd persistent chat session
desc: Each `wkappbot chat` interactive session auto-registers itself in HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run keyed by cwd hash so the same chat reopens at next login. Skipped when stdin/stdout is redirected (scripts/CI), when re-entering from the previous startup (WKAPPBOT_CHAT_FROM_STARTUP=1), and when --no-autostart is passed (which also unregisters). Idempotent per-process via Interlocked CAS.
steps: [REGISTRY KEY SHAPE] Subkey: Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run. Value name: WKAppBot_Chat_{cwdHash} where cwdHash is an 8-char digest of Environment.CurrentDirectory (case-insensitive). Per-cwd keying lets users have separate persistent chats in WKAppBot, WkAutoQuant, WkFeedQuant, etc., all auto-restoring after reboot.

[VALUE FORMAT] cmd /c "set WKAPPBOT_CHAT_FROM_STARTUP=1 && start "" "<wt.exe>" --window 0 nt -d "<cwd>" "<wkappbot.exe>" chat". The WKAPPBOT_CHAT_FROM_STARTUP=1 marker is the silent re-entry guard -- when chat re-launches itself on next login, EnsureChatAutoStartupRegistration sees this env var and skips registry churn. start "" detaches so the spawning cmd.exe can exit cleanly.

[ENTRY POINT] EnsureChatAutoStartupRegistration(args) called once at ChatCommand entry. First line: Interlocked.Exchange(ref _chatAutoStartupChecked, 1) -- if already 1 returns immediately. Chat re-enters its own command for AI-REPL routes; CAS gate prevents duplicate registrations on the same process.

[SKIP CONDITIONS] (1) --no-autostart in args -> call TryUnregisterChatStartup(keyName) and return. Lets users opt out without manually editing the registry. (2) Console.IsInputRedirected || Console.IsOutputRedirected -> non-interactive launch (scripted, piped); registering would silently auto-launch on every login which is hostile. (3) WKAPPBOT_CHAT_FROM_STARTUP=1 -> we ARE the previous startup launching itself; do not re-write.

[REGISTER PATH] BuildChatStartupCommand assembles the cmd /c launcher. TryRegisterChatStartup opens HKCU Run subkey writable, compares existing value -> outcomes: set (new key created), updated (value changed), already-set (no-op silent). 'set' and 'updated' write a [CHAT:AUTOSTART] line to stderr; 'already-set' is silent to avoid noise on every chat launch.

[UNREGISTER PATH] TryUnregisterChatStartup deletes the value if present. Reasons logged: not-present (already absent), removed (deleted ok), failed (registry permission etc). All routed via stderr [CHAT:AUTOSTART] so users see the result of --no-autostart.

[SAFETY] Outer try/catch wraps the entire entry function -- any registry hiccup (locked hive, permission, transient failure) is swallowed silently. Auto-startup is convenience, not a critical path; chat MUST start regardless. No throws, no blocking.

[INTERACTION WITH BANNER + GEOMETRY] Order at chat entry: (1) PrintCallerHostBranding, (2) EnsureChatAutoStartupRegistration, (3) PrintWelcomeBanner, (4) RestoreParentWindowGeo, (5) prompt. Auto-startup registration happens early so even if the banner or geometry probe crashes the registry entry is already updated.
